newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Q2 securities profits fall from Q1 gains.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Q2 securities profits fall from Q1 gains.

text.p: Operating profits in Canada's securities industry fell in the second quarter after uninterrupted gains in the previous three quarters, the Investment Dealers Association of Canada on Wednesday.
Operating profit dropped to C$469 million, down 9.0 percent from C$514 million last quarter, the association said. Net profit edged up to C$203 million from C$194 million.
Weak retail and institutional equity business pulled down profits as investors responded to a drop on Toronto Stock Exchange over late May and June, the group said.
Revenue from the fixed income side fell through 1996 in response to falling spreads between bids and offers on Canadian bonds. Spreads are half of year-earlier levels, it said.
